title: 第二章 说杀便杀
novel_title: 方彻刚刚更新内容(长夜君主)
content_zh: 七月半的阳光毒辣的照射着大地，当头而落，树木的树荫被压缩成一小圈。群山万壑，连一丝微风都没有。大地如绿浪一般的森林，叶子在闪亮，在汲取大地的养分，但，依然能感觉到树叶们的无精打采。它们在坚持，坚持到风来，云来，或者太阳偏移，不再这么毒辣，就能有喘息的时间。但，现在树林前的两个人，却是精神振奋，意气风发。看起来，比树叶要坚挺的多了。看这两人的脸色眼神，活像是一座金山，已经摆在了他们面前，就等着伸手去拿。也有越来越多的武生不由自主远远旁观。看来，是遇到劫道的了？大家都很好奇，车厢里这个人，该怎么应对？据说是义薄云天方公子？……方彻咳嗽一声。夜梦急忙快步上前，躬身，两只白嫩的小手掀开马车门帘。一只脚率先踏出，穿着做工考究的黑色皮靴，皮靴上还有暗金的暗纹。一脚坚定沉稳的踩在地上，踩动微尘扩散，展现出优美修长匀称的小腿形状。随即，一头黑发钻出车厢，黑发茂密，一圈暗金发箍扎住，在阳光下，折射出迷离的颜色。发箍足有鹅蛋粗，足见发量多么茂密茁壮。一根紫玉发簪斜斜插过头发，固定发箍。两侧紫光竟然氤氲。另一只脚同步落在地面。一袭黑色大氅，镶着暗金色的花纹，身体缓缓直立。露出一张英俊的脸。眉浓如剑，不修自有飞出眉际穿破天穹的锋锐。眉毛下。目光如星辰大海，深邃沉凝。面如美玉，不见一丝瑕疵。鼻子挺直，嘴唇微薄，抿起，露出一个优雅的弧度。唇红齿白，眸正目清。黑发一丝不苟的挽起，却有一缕斜垂耳后，丝丝飘动。肩宽背直，微微显瘦，大氅随便的敞开，露出猿臂蜂腰，修长有力的双腿，说不出的挺拔俊秀。就这么一站，已经是如同临风玉树，风度俨然，却又气度沉凝，渊渟岳峙。方彻脚步一动，往前三步。优雅从容，若在云端漫步。随着走动，大氅上暗金暗纹便如波浪起伏，阳光下一道道亮光折射而出，随即消失，然后别处无数不同位置，又在光芒闪烁。走动之间，如同随身带着星河千万。只是这一个亮相。所有人眼中便似乎齐齐的有了光，忍不住心中一声喝彩：好风采！端的称得上‘陌上人如玉，公子世无双’这十个字！不得不说，就连夜梦，在看到的时候，眼神中也忍不住迷离了一下。刹那间感觉，被这样的人骂几句，似乎也没什么。更何况他骂的对！……对面两人被他风神所慑，竟然一时间说不出话。方彻淡淡道：“两位是要找我？不知有何见教。”“呃……”对面的高個子光头上细汗微微，终于回过神来，看到方彻的容貌，对比自己之下，骤然感觉心中一股邪火腾腾冒了起来。顿时暴怒道：“方彻！你可知我是谁？”方彻一伸手，夜梦很乖巧的双手递过来一张雪白的手帕。很优雅的在自己手上擦了擦，漫不经心道：“你是谁？”“我是苏越的表舅。”那汉子丑脸上露出一丝狰狞和贪婪：“听闻方公子替我外甥掌管家资，得知消息后紧赶慢赶，终究还是在公子离开之前赶到了。”“哦。”方彻微笑，露出洁白的牙齿：“不知道这位舅舅，想要如何？”“想要干什么，这还用说么？我可怜的外甥一家死光了，我这个做舅舅的，自然要帮他守好家产，今日来见方公子，便是如此。”方彻有趣的笑了起来：“所以你这一趟来，是来要钱的？”光头汉子理直气壮：“正是。”方彻微笑负手而立，大氅无风自动，光芒映射：“你想要多少？”“最低要先给我一百万两！”光头汉子眼中露出贪婪。“呵……”方彻淡淡的笑了。苏家资产，数以亿计，还有无数金票，各种珍奇宝贝，一百万两？这汉子估计就是想要沾点光，但是距离碧波城太近，还不敢下手，所以只能一路跟到这里。而且还不敢入万灵之森。说明实力低微。没见识，实力还低——应该是别人的一个探路的棋子。方彻心里顿时放了心，淡淡道：“苏大哥的家产在我手里不假，不过你想要，除非有苏大哥的手谕，或者有镇守大殿的条子证明你是苏家血脉。”“若是随便来个猫猫狗狗都能从我这里拿钱走，我方彻如何能对得住苏大哥？！”方彻笑了一下，眼神冰冷：“不要说什么舅舅之类的话，凭本事来拿吧！”“正要凭……”光头汉子一句话刚出口。眼前光芒一闪，方彻已经大步往前一迈，光芒骤然一闪。锵。一声剑离鞘的声音响起。却看不到剑在何方。
content_en: The half-July sunshine shone fiercely on the earth, and when it fell, the shade of the trees was compressed into a small circle.There are so many mountains and valleys, and not even a breeze.The earth is like a green wave in the forest, and the leaves are shining, absorbing nutrients from the earth, but you can still feel the listlessness of the leaves.They are persisting, persisting until the wind comes, the clouds come, or the sun shifts, and it is no longer so vicious, and they can have time to breathe.However, the two people in front of the woods now are in high spirits and high spirits.It looks much stronger than leaves.Judging from the expressions and eyes of these two people, it was as if a golden mountain had been placed in front of them, just waiting to reach out and take it.There are also more and more martial arts students who can't help but watch from a distance.It seems that he has encountered a calamity?Everyone is curious, how should we deal with this person in the carriage?It is said that he is Mr. Yi Boyuntianfang?...Fang Che coughed.Ye Meng hurried forward, bowed, and opened the carriage door curtain with his two white hands.One foot stepped out first, wearing well-made black leather boots with dark gold patterns on them.One foot stepped firmly and steadily on the ground, causing the dust to spread, revealing the shape of the beautiful, slender and well-proportioned calves.Immediately, a head of black hair emerged from the carriage. The black hair was thick and tied with a circle of dark blond hair. In the sunlight, it reflected a blurred color.The headband is as thick as a goose egg, which shows how thick and strong the hair is.A purple jade hairpin is inserted diagonally through the hair to secure the headband.The purple light on both sides was actually dense.The other foot lands simultaneously on the ground.Wearing a black cloak with dark golden patterns, his body slowly stood upright.Showing a handsome face.The eyebrows are as thick as a sword. If not cultivated, it will be sharp enough to fly out of the eyebrows and pierce the sky.Under the eyebrows.His gaze is like a sea of ​​stars, deep and concentrated.Her face was like beautiful jade, without a single flaw.The nose is straight and the lips are thin and pursed, revealing an elegant arc.Red lips, white teeth, clear eyes.The black hair was pulled up meticulously, but there was a strand hanging behind the ears, fluttering.The shoulders are wide and the back is straight, slightly thin. The cloak is casually opened, revealing the ape-like arms and waist. The slender and powerful legs are indescribably tall and handsome.Just standing there like this is like a jade tree standing in the wind, with a graceful demeanor but a calm demeanor, standing tall in the distance.Fang Che moved his steps and took three steps forward.Elegant and calm, as if walking on the clouds.As he moved around, the dark golden patterns on the cloak undulated like waves, and bright lights refracted out under the sunlight, then disappeared, and then flickered again in countless different locations elsewhere.When walking around, it's like carrying millions of stars with you.Just this one appearance.Everyone's eyes seemed to light up, and they couldn't help but cheer in their hearts: What a style!He can truly be said to be worthy of these ten words: "The people on the road are like jade, and the young master is unparalleled in the world"!It has to be said that even Ye Meng couldn't help but get confused in his eyes when he saw it.For a moment, I felt that being scolded by such a person didn't seem to matter.What's more, his scolding was right!...The two people opposite were so frightened by his wind spirit that they were speechless for a moment.Fang Che said calmly: "Are you two looking for me? I don't know what I can teach you." "Uh..." The tall man opposite was sweating lightly on his bald head. He finally came back to his senses, saw Fang Che's appearance, and compared it with his own, suddenly felt an evil fire rising in his heart.Suddenly he said angrily: "Fang Che! Do you know who I am?" Fang Che stretched out his hand, and Ye Meng's clever hands handed over a snow-white handkerchief.He wiped his hands gracefully and said casually: "Who are you?" "I am Su Yue's cousin." A hint of ferocity and greed appeared on the man's ugly face: "I heard that Young Master Fang is in charge of the family assets for my nephew.After hearing the news, I hurriedly arrived before the young master left."Oh."Fang Che smiled, showing his white teeth: "I don't know what this uncle wants.""What do you want to do?"My poor nephew's family is all dead. As an uncle, I naturally have to help him protect his family property.That's why I came to see Mr. Fang today." Fang Che laughed interestingly: "So you are here to ask for money.?”The bald man said confidently, “That’s right.”Fang Che stood with his hands behind his hands, his cloak reflecting in the wind, “How much do you want?”“The minimum is one million taels!”The bald man’s eyes showed greed."Heh..." Fang Che smiled faintly.The Su family's assets are in the hundreds of millions, as well as countless golden tickets, various rare treasures, one million taels?This man probably just wanted to get some glory, but he was too close to Bibo City and didn't dare to make a move, so he could only follow him all the way here.And he didn’t dare to enter the Forest of All Spirits.It shows that the strength is low.He has no knowledge, and his strength is still low - he should be someone else's pawn to find a way.Fang Che suddenly felt relieved and said calmly: "It's true that Brother Su's family property is in my hands, but if you want it, unless you have Brother Su's handwriting or a note guarding the hall to prove that you are of Su family blood." "If a cat or dog comes randomly,If you can take money from me, how can I, Fang Che, stand up to Brother Su?" Fang Che smiled, his eyes cold: "Don't say anything like uncle, just take it based on your ability!" "Just rely on it..." The bald man just said this.There was a flash of light in front of his eyes. Fang Che had already taken a big step forward, and the light suddenly flashed.Clang.There was a sound of a sword being unsheathed.But I can't see where the sword is.
